messages:
erin: Morning — planning to publish the next Python & TS SDK packages at 09:00 PT (canary -> cohort -> stable). Intention: cut canary, smoke, then promote. Deprecation note for the sync client (v1.x) should go out with the stable publish. Please don't queue any other publishes during 08:50-09:30 change window.

deploy-bot: @erin scheduled: canary publish queued (canary-tag). Job: #9472 started. CI: lint/test pass. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/9472

sam: quick checklist: dist signing in place? npm dist-tag will be `canary` then `latest` on promote. For PyPI we use twine to upload to test.pypi then pypi on promote. Example upload command: ```twine upload dist/* -u __token__ -p $PYPI_TOKEN --repository pypi```

maya: QA: I'll run the smoke suite after canary lands. If smoke fails I'll post a red `STOP` and request a rollback. Expected run <10m.
josh: FYI saw intermittent 502s from the mirror earlier this morning (09:05 PT). Recommend staggered cohort rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50%. Keep quick rollback hook. :eyes:

release-manager: Proposal: pin internal integrations to v2.3.1 until cohort A stable (automated pin via distro config). Rollback criteria: >=5% error increase over baseline OR 15% latency P95 regression OR failed smoke for cohort A. If any of these hit, we revert disttag and yank npm publish, and yank PyPI wheel + set docs deprec flag.

erin: Good. Clarify pins: platform-config will point to `2.3.1` for the next 48h, then auto-shift on stable promotion. Who will flip the pins if we need to rollback? @release-manager

release-manager: I'll coordinate pin flip and send a quick config PR and notif. If rollback required, I'll tag the rollback and notify support and eng-sre channels.

sam: Adding publishing checklist here so we don't forget: 1) bump changelog + deprec blurb, 2) build wheels and sdists, 3) verify signatures, 4) upload canary, 5) wait for smoke ✅, 6) promote cohorts. I'll push a short script for step 3-4: ```./scripts/publish-canary.sh --tag canary```

maya: Smoke passed on canary (09:01 PT) — core tests green, basic E2E + auth ok. No regressions observed. Holding promote to cohort A until 09:05 for third-party flakiness check.
josh: Observability team set canary rate at 2% and created dashboards. Link: https://metrics.redwood.ai/dash/shiproom-canary. I'll watch errors/latency for the next 15m.
deploy-bot: canary publish completed and registered: npm:@redwood/sdk-js@canary, pypi:@redwood-sdk==2.4.0rc1. Cohort promotion scheduled in 4m.

erin: OK — promote to cohort A at 09:05 PT. Reminder: if we see spike threshold hit, we revert immediately. Release notes PR ready: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/432 — includes deprecation text: "Sync client (v1.x) deprecated — migrate to AsyncClient. See migration guide."

maya: Promote done. Cohort A is live (2% traffic). Monitoring for 10m.
josh: Watching — no errors yet, latency flat. If stable at 09:15 we can move to 10% cohort.

release-manager: All good, if no flags by 09:20 we'll promote to stable and push deprecation notice to docs and changelog. I will also create the internal pin PR to keep infra on 2.3.1 until 48h post-stable.

erin: Thanks team. Post-publish followups: update release notes with exact migration examples, check telemetry for any client-side parsing errors, and schedule a quick retro if we had to rollback.

josh: noted. Setting an alert for client parse errors and an automated rollback doc snippet.

maya: I'll unlock final promote at 09:20. If nothing fires I'll promote and tag stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: cohort A metrics: errors 0.4% (baseline 0.3%), P95 latency +2%. No rollback triggered.

erin: Promote to stable at 09:21 PT. Release done — publishing stable tags and publishing docs deprecation banner. I'll follow up with a short announcement in #general and the changelog.

release-manager: Pin PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infrastructure/configs/pulls/512 — sets internal SDK pin to 2.3.1 for 48h. If we need to lift earlier, comment here and I'll action.

sam: Thanks — verify clients and SDK consumers tomorrow morning for any unexpected classifier drift.

erin: Closing thread. If anyone spots anything odd in the next 24h, call it out in #eng-oncall and ping me. :white_check_mark:
